STATUS = ACTIVE SINGLE PRODUCT / MASTER STREAM
ROOT = DUNCAN PRIME
DURABLE RESET = comment `5506451195`
MAIN_AT_RESET = `b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1`
BRANCH = `duncan/zorr-studio-r01`

## PURPOSE
Replace the previous parallel CHAT A / B / C execution topology with one authoritative product stream after repeated stale-state / competing-NEXT regressions.

## ACTIVE TOPOLOGY
`ONE ACTIVE PRODUCT STREAM = #251`

- #249 parallel CHAT A topology = retired / historical workstream.
- #250 parallel CHAT B topology = retired after PREP delivery; its camera/S001 contracts remain reusable evidence.
- #248 = supporting costume-mechanics QC library, not the active universal hard gate.
- SHERIFF = independent evidence/discipline monitor only, never a product executor.
- Automations may monitor or perform one explicitly delegated bounded task but may not create a competing `ACTIVE_BASE`, product route, or NEXT.

## CURRENT PROVEN FOUNDATION
- #245 `FULL_CHARACTER_MODEL_LOCK_R02 = PASS` remains the locked character-model foundation.
- Existing accepted character pack / C00 references remain authority; do not reopen generic BODY/HAIR/HANDS or source recovery without fresh contradictory evidence.
- #250 PREP artifacts for camera/S001 are reusable and do not need to be recreated.

## #248 ROLE AFTER RESET
The six costume controls remain useful diagnostics/QC rules.

`W01 ARM_RAISE` is a high-information shoulder/armhole/lapel/armpit mechanics control, but it is **not a mandatory film frame** and is no longer a standalone prerequisite for every unrelated production pose.

Apply the relevant #248 control(s) to actual production key drawings when that force exists. Run standalone diagnostics only when a real product artifact exposes a concrete mechanics uncertainty/regression.

## ACTIVE PRODUCT OBJECTIVE
`FIRST_REAL_PRODUCTION_KEY_DRAWING / SCENE-BOUND POSE CANDIDATE`

Product-first sequence:
`REAL PRODUCT ARTIFACT -> RELEVANT IDENTITY/BODY/COSTUME/POSE QC -> REPAIR ONLY FAILED LAYER -> CAMERA/S001 BINDING WHEN LEGAL -> NEXT REAL ARTIFACT`

Do not create synthetic gate artifacts merely to prove process when the same invariant can be checked on the real product drawing.

## HARD LAWS
- GitHub fresh evidence wins.
- One active base / one active product NEXT.
- No new parallel chat topology.
- No source/Krita/OpenToonz rediscovery unless a fresh real product blocker requires it.
- No PASS from schedule/activity/summary.
- No character/costume redesign by accident.
- No W01-specific fixation unless the actual production pose uses that force or a concrete regression calls for the diagnostic.

## OUTPUT CONTRACT
`RESULT / DELTA / EVIDENCE / NEXT`

Every NEXT must point to one real product artifact or one exact first broken layer that blocks that artifact.

`W01 ARM_RAISE` is a high-information shoulder/armhole/lapel/armpit diagnostic, **not a mandatory film frame** and not a standalone prerequisite for unrelated product poses.

Apply only the control(s) relevant to the actual production artifact. Standalone diagnostics are legal only for a concrete mechanics uncertainty/regression.

## CURRENT PRODUCT BLOCKER
Fresh post-reset recovery establishes:

`FIRST_REAL_SHOT_INTENT_NOT_PROVEN`

The S001 technical contract exists, but its actual story beat, character action/pose, primary read, framing, duration, camera and output are not durably selected/locked.

Repository recovery found historical/training approved scene facts but no authoritative mapping of one exact beat to `S001 = first production shot`. Do not infer that mapping.

`RECOVER AUTHORITATIVE STORY/SHOT INTENT`
-> if an exact first production shot already exists, bind it;
-> otherwise require one explicit OWNER creative selection/authorization;
-> persist `SHOT_ID + STORY_BEAT + CHARACTER_ACTION + PRIMARY_READ`;
-> produce/select the real key drawing / scene-bound pose;
-> apply only relevant identity/body/costume/pose QC;
-> repair only failed layers;
-> resolve camera/S001 technical fields required by that actual shot;
-> continue toward golden keyframe / animation from real evidence.

## RETIRED DEFAULT BLOCKERS
Do not reactivate without fresher explicit OWNER authority or concrete product-regression evidence:
- CHAT A/B/C topology;
- #248/W01 as universal hard gate;
- six synthetic costume witnesses before unrelated product work;
- Krita/exact MASTER FRONT direct-edit binding;
- source-pack rediscovery from zero;
- local OpenToonz absence as global blocker.

## OUTPUT CONTRACT
`RESULT / DELTA / EVIDENCE / NEXT`

Every NEXT must name one real product artifact or the exact first blocker preventing it. No PASS from activity, schedule, summary or transient one-chat image.
